description: AICTIONBOT™ AI use case check by KULIC Advisory, built on the Execution Toolkit template T27 (AI use case governance). Takes the use case card (problem, decision supported, expected value, users, accountable owner, human oversight, success metric, fallback without AI), data readiness ratings 1 to 5 (availability, quality, access, freshness, history), yes or no answers to five risk questions (personal data, decisions about people, external effect, money moves, explainability) and the planned controls with owner and status. Returns what is missing, data readiness, open controls, notes where impact is high and oversight low, and a signal following the template rule: proceed only when data, controls and ownership are clear, otherwise pilot, redesign or stop. Checks completeness and controllability; it is not a legal classification, for example under the EU AI Act. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).
